name: evlek
description: Live Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC) property listings and asking-price data from evlek.app. Read-only, 8 tools.

interface.longDescription:
Evlek brings live Northern Cyprus (KKTC/TRNC) property listings into ChatGPT. Ask in Turkish, English, Russian, German or Arabic and Evlek shows matching homes for sale and long-term rent as cards with their real photos; in ChatGPT a "Show on map" button opens a full-screen map of every match, grouped by neighbourhood.

You can open any listing for its price, rooms, built and plot area, approximate location, features and a link to the listing on evlek.app, compare two to four listings side by side, see asking-price statistics for a city or district (medians, price per m² and listing counts), list the places Evlek knows, and convert an amount between GBP, EUR, USD and TRY at the rates Evlek stores.

All tools are read-only and need no account. Evlek reports advertised asking prices and listing facts only: it gives no valuation, forecast, ranking, investment, legal, title or tax advice, does not cover holiday rentals, and never includes contact details — the user is sent to the listing page on evlek.app. A gross area is always labelled as gross and never gets a price per m².
defaultPrompt: Show me apartments for sale in Kyrenia under £300,000.
What are the median asking prices for apartments for sale in Kyrenia?

positive.description: Search: sale listings in one city under a price ceiling, shown as photo cards.
positive.prompt: Show me apartments for sale in Kyrenia under £300,000.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings (transaction sale, city Kyrenia, propertyType apartment, priceMax 300000). The listing-cards widget shows photo cards with price, rooms, district and area; a gross area is labelled "… m² (gross)" and no price per m² is shown. A "Show on map" button opens a full-screen map of the matches grouped by neighbourhood. The tool returns only listings from evlek.app and no contact details.

positive.description: Listing detail by listing number, including a gross area.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_listing with ref EVL-101366. The listing-detail widget shows the photo gallery, GBP 153,000, a 2+1 apartment in Girne Merkez (Kyrenia) and "85 m² (gross)". The tool output labels the area as gross, includes no price per m² and no phone number or e-mail; the user is linked to the listing on evlek.app.

positive.prompt: What are the median asking prices for apartments for sale in Kyrenia?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls market_stats (city Kyrenia, transaction sale, propertyType apartment). The price-index widget shows the median asking price, median asking price per m², the sample size and district rows; districts with fewer than 10 sampled listings are withheld. The tool labels the figures as advertised asking prices, not sale prices or valuations.

Calls compare_listings with EVL-101366 and EVL-101348. The tool returns the facts side by side: price, room layout, bathrooms, area (both 85 m² gross), location, furnishing, features, office and listing date. The tool output contains no ranking, no recommendation and no price per m² for gross areas.

positive.description: Currency conversion at the rates Evlek stores.
positive.prompt: Convert £250,000 to euros, dollars and Turkish lira.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls convert_currency (amount 250000, currency GBP). Returns the EUR, USD and TRY equivalents with the rate source and update time, and states it is a currency conversion only (no payment plan, tax or fee estimate).

negative.description: A listing number that does not exist: no invented listing.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls get_listing with ref EVL-999999. The tool answers found:false with code NOT_FOUND (not an error) and the widget says "This listing is no longer available." No price, photo or feature is invented.

negative.description: A place outside Northern Cyprus: no listings from elsewhere.
negative.prompt: Show me apartments for sale in Paris.
negative.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with city Paris (or list_locations first). The tool returns 0 results with code INVALID_LOCATION and the widget says "That place was not found in Northern Cyprus." No listings from other countries are returned.

negative.description: A request for an agent's private contact details: none are returned.
negative.prompt: Give me the phone number of the agent selling EVL-101366.
negative.expected_behavior: May call get_listing (EVL-101366). The tool output never contains phone numbers, e-mail addresses or other contact details; the reply names the listing office at most and sends the user to the listing page on evlek.app to make contact.

review.commerce_description: Evlek does not sell products or process payments. It shows public property listings and asking-price data; buyers and renters contact the listing office through evlek.app.

publication.release_notes: 3.1.4: every area says its basis ("85 m² (gross)" / "Gross area"; a gross area is never called indoor and gets no price per m²); the widgets ask for at most 2 sentences and are not restated; no ranking, recommendation or valuation in listing, comparison and market answers; not-found and unknown-place messages follow the answer language.
